name: Miyan Kuka
description: A hearty soup prepared from powdered baobab leaves and served with fufu or rice.

name: Tuwo Shinkafa
description: A soft rice-based swallow eaten with sauces and stews during family gatherings.

name: Fura da Nono
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink made from fermented milk (nono) and ground millet (fura).

name: Pate (Acha)
description: A traditional porridge made from fonio grain (acha), often cooked with vegetables and spices.
